reviews.title: Ship Finder Review
reviews.text: Bought this from the App Store for £4.99, and it’s not even displaying ships that I can see in front of me on the Clyde. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Simply doesn’t work properly
reviews.text: I’m at a major cruise port looking out over 5 massive cruise ships, tugs, bunkers etc etc. yet the app shows an empty port!  Waste of money.

reviews.title: What Did I Purchase
reviews.text:
I just purchased this app to view the route or vessels. I spent time looking for how to search for a specific vessel. 
I would love someone from the app to let me know why I can’t any vessels and their routes.

reviews.title: Curious
reviews.text: Lacking coverage. Why is the Panama Canal showing zero marine traffic? The entirety of the Suez Canal. Both the southern,central and northern portions of which show zero traffic . South Korea and vicinity, no traffic shown. The three locations previously mentioned have some of the highest rates of shipping traffic in the world . Indian Ocean, South China Sea, mid Atlantic, mid Pacific Ocean no traffic shown. Kodiak Island, the Aleutian chain chain no traffic shown.

reviews.title: Doesn’t show ships in my port
reviews.text: We’ve been in Saint Lucia and can see ships come and go from our port but they’re not shown on the app. I have made a “ contact us” enquiry but have had no reply

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Started off good on the ship my family was on and then all of a sudden it couldn’t find it at all.  Also looked up another popular cruise ship and it never did find it.  3 other tracker sites had no problem with either one.  Can’t believe I wasted $4.99 on this app.

reviews.title: Annoyed purchaser
reviews.text: This app does not show any marine traffic in the greater Atlantic basin, not worth the fee paid
